fields.name: items
fields.label: Items
fields.help: Expression that evaluates to the array to iterate

fields.name: batch_size
fields.label: Batch Size
fields.help: Number of items processed per batch

fields.name: continue_on_error
fields.label: Continue On Error
fields.help: Continue iteration when an item fails

fields.name: body_concurrency
fields.label: Body Concurrency
fields.help: Maximum items of one batch running at the same time; 1 (the default) runs them serially

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body
fields.help: Sub-graph executed once per item; mutually exclusive with expression, and exactly one of the two is required

fields.name: expression
fields.label: Expression
fields.help: Expression evaluated once per item over $item/$index/$items; mutually exclusive with body, and exactly one of the two is required
